claims.quote: The physical meeting space shall be the following location:  Council Chambers - 200 West Walker Street, League City, Texas.

Matching /license plate|flock|alpr|camera/i case-insensitively across every item title returns nothing. What this does NOT say, and no frame may: that the council will not reach the question on some other date, or that item 39, ITEMS ADDED AFTER ELECTRONIC AGENDA COMPLETED, will stay empty. It says the posted final agenda names no camera item. c16's fence said the record could not establish the question WAS on that agenda. This is the stronger and opposite finding and it is why the closing frame changed.
